d: This is Maharashtra—a land where the glorious history of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj’s forts stands alongside the ancient architectural heritage of the Ajanta and Ellora caves. It is a place where deep, surging faith finds expression in the vibrant *pandals* of Bappa and the sacred shrines of Shirdi, while the fast-paced rhythm of Mumbai—the city of dreams—serves as the nation’s economic heartbeat. From the iconic taste of *vada pav* and the graceful flair of *Lavani* folk dance to the pristine beaches of the Konkan coast and the scenic valleys of Mahabaleshwar and Lonavala—Maharashtra is…
